description:
Preview a template with sample data before saving, as a sub-account would send it. Shows how the message will look with placeholder variables filled in.

ACCESS: needs a Proof account. Authenticate this client (Claude Code: /mcp → Authenticate), then call this tool again. start_login does NOT open this tool.

profile_id.description: The sub-account to act on; omitted → your key's sub-account, or the primary sub-account for an account-wide key

name: preview_template

warnings.description: What a save would warn about; never makes `is_valid` false. Always sent; absent from an API that predates it.
